newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico stocks extend slide on certification woes.
newsitem.headline: Mexico stocks extend slide on certification woes.

text.p: Mexican stocks extended their earlier slide in late trade on concerns the U.S. Congress would vote to decertify Mexico's combat against drug-trafficking, traders said.
"More sellers stepped in the market...we all know why. It's the certification process and soaring interest rates," a floor trader said.
The leading IPC share index was down 54.14 points in the closing half-hour of trade, or 1.42 percent, at 3,749.98.
